r.name: Boundary Walk, Hughenden
r.description: This 4-mile walk broadly follows the outer boundary of the Hughenden Estate. It allows you to explore beautiful woodland, open parkland, farmland and a rare chalk stream. No stiles, some steep slopes, a short road section & slippery sections when wet.

r.name: Cliveden Green Walking Trail, Cliveden
r.description: On this short stroll explore the woodlands, discover a former owner of the estate & take in views of the River Thames, surrounding countryside & Cliveden House. Option to extend your walk to visit Cliveden gardens. Gentle slopes & flat terrain.
National Cycle Network link route to NCN 61

r.name: Chiltern Heritage Trail Temporary Diversion
r.description: Two alternative routes to divert Chiltern Heritage Trail around HS2 works north of Great Missenden. The "northern" route is signed and more off road, but misses out more of the original trail.

r.name: Cliveden Blue Walking Trail, Cliveden
r.description: A family-friendly woodland walk with opportunities to explore. Discover our natural den, complete with tree trunk picnic tables & try out the rope swing & balancing beams along our Play Trail. Flat terrain. Gentle slopes. Muddy in places.

r.name: Cliveden Gold Walking Trail, Cliveden
r.description: Take in tranquil riverside scenery, shady woodland, dramatic views of the Berkshire countryside and places of historical interest on this circular trail. Some steep parts.

r.name: Cliveden Woodland Walking Trail, Cliveden
r.description: Explore the woodland at Cliveden on this moderate walk taking in a play trail for the kids, picnic areas and spectacular views over the River Thames and the surrounding countryside. Mostly flat with gentle slopes. Some puddles in wetter months.

r.name: The Long Wind in the Willows Walk, Maidenhead
r.description: A moderate circular exploring the rural community of Cookham Dean & the Woodland Trust's Wild Wood at Quarry & Fultness Woods. Pass through farmland, woodland & along the village lanes that inspired Kenneth Grahame, author of Wind in the Willows.

r.name: Cookham and Cock Marsh Walk, Maidenhead
r.description: Follow this circular walk along riverside paths, through lush meadows and over chalk grassland slopes and enjoy panoramic views across the Thames Valley. Trail includes one short, sttep climb and a kissing gate that is difficult to navigate in a wheelchai

r.name: Cookham Wetland and Wildlife Trial, Maidenhead
r.description: Follow this leisurely 2.8-mile circular walk south from Cookham Moor along the Strand Water, meeting up with White Brook stream and Widbrook Common before rejoining the moor. Level ground on soft footpaths. Area prone to flooding. No stiles.

r.name: The Short Wind in the Willows Walk, Maidenhead
r.description: Enjoy this shorter walk through the attractive, unspoilt village of Cookham Dean before passing the boyhood home of Kenneth Grahame, author of 'The Wind in the Willows'. Continue through Quarry & Fultness Woods - the inspiration for Grahame's 'Wild Wood'
